pack.description: Illustrative example pack: basic fire safety, camp setup, and warmth maintenance steps. Educational sample content for the ODY format.

sources.title: General camp fire safety and warmth preparation guidance (illustrative example)

entries.title: Preparing a safe fire site
entries.summary: Clear dry leaves and debris to establish a safe fire pit away from overhanging branches.
entries.detail: Select a flat area sheltered from strong wind. Clear a circular area of flammable debris down to bare soil and surround the pit with stones if available.
actions: Select a flat site clear of overhanging branches
Clear dry leaves and brush down to bare dirt
Create a stone border around the fire area
checklist: Site is away from dry vegetation and tents
A clearing of at least 3 feet is cleared around the pit
decision_rules: If winds are high or dry conditions exist, avoid lighting an open fire
If near low branches, choose an alternate site
prohibitions: Do not build a fire near dry grass or under low tree branches
Do not leave a burning fire unattended

entries.title: Extinguishing a campfire safely
entries.summary: Douse embers completely with water, stir the ashes, and confirm everything is cold to touch.
entries.detail: Pour water onto all embers, stir the ash pile with a stick or shovel, and pour more water until no steam rises and embers are completely cold.
actions: Pour water over embers and burning wood
Stir the ash and embers thoroughly
Touch the ashes gently to ensure they are completely cold
checklist: Water or dirt is readily available near the fire site
Ashes are completely cold to touch before leaving
decision_rules: If steam or heat is still rising, continue adding water and stirring
If water is scarce, smother thoroughly with dirt or sand and stir
prohibitions: Do not abandon hot embers or smoldering ash
Do not bury hot coals without fully cooling them first

entries.title: Retaining warmth through clothing layering
entries.summary: Use clothing layering to manage body heat, moisture, and wind exposure in cold weather.
entries.detail: Wear a moisture-wicking base layer, an insulating middle layer for warmth retention, and a wind-resistant outer shell to protect against cold air.
actions: Wear a synthetic or wool base layer to manage moisture
Add a fleece or insulated mid-layer for warmth
Cover with a windproof shell during windy or damp conditions
checklist: Clothing layers are dry and uncompressed
Outer shell provides adequate wind protection
decision_rules: If sweating occurs, shed an insulation layer to remain dry
If feeling cold while stationary, add an insulating layer before chilling sets in
prohibitions: Do not wear wet cotton clothing in cold environments
Do not allow insulation layers to become damp
